CustomObject.description: Represents a triggered financial-reconciliation event sent to SAP on loan-to-sale conversion. Published by HAV_LoanToSaleService (one event per return line and per reissue line, mirroring the MSO two-line pattern). In the demo this stands in for a MuleSoft-to-SAP integration; no live SAP call is made.
CustomObject.label: SAP Reconciliation
